# featbit_feature_flag (Data Source)

Reads one active FeatBit Feature Flag by exact Environment UUID and case-sensitive key.

The lookup requires an exact, case-sensitive key in one exact Environment and
checks complete active and archived views. An absent or archived flag produces
a diagnostic instead of returning a different match. The data source exposes
the canonical definition, not targeting, rollout, enabled-state, or tag data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "environment_id" {
  description = "Exact parent FeatBit Environment UUID."
  type        = string
}

variable "feature_flag_key" {
  description = "Exact case-sensitive FeatBit Feature Flag key."
  type        = string
}

data "featbit_feature_flag" "exact" {
  environment_id = var.environment_id
  key            = var.feature_flag_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Exact parent Environment UUID.
- `key` (String) Exact case-sensitive Feature Flag key.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Feature Flag description, canonicalized to an empty string when absent.
- `id` (String) Feature Flag UUID.
- `name` (String) Feature Flag display name.
- `variation_type` (String) Canonical lowercase variation type.
- `variations` (Attributes List) Canonical Feature Flag variations ordered by exact UUID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variations))

<a id="nestedatt--variations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variations`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Variation UUID.
- `name` (String) Variation display name.
- `value` (String) Canonical variation value.
